# Bundled browser dependencies

- `supabase.js`: `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.57.4**, its published UMD bundle, MIT license.
- `chart.umd.min.js`: `chart.js` **4.5.1**, its published UMD bundle, MIT license.

Copies of both licenses are included in this directory. No frontend package installation or external CDN fetch is required.
